tools.description: Create projects, tags or folders in one batch. parent is a folder id (project, folder) or tag id (tag); omit for the root. Optional status (project Active/OnHold/Done, tag Active/OnHold) and sequential (project). Returns one result per item (id, ok/error, name, status, parent); a bad item does not stop the others.

items.description: projects, tags or folders to create, applied in order

parent.description: folder id (project, folder) or tag id (tag); omit for the root

sequential.description: project only: sequential instead of parallel

status.description: project: Active, OnHold, Done; tag: Active, OnHold

tools.name: add

tools.description: Create tasks in one batch. Each task goes to the inbox unless project or parent is given. Optional estimatedMinutes, repetition {rule (RRULE), scheduleType Regularly|FromCompletion, anchor DeferDate|DueDate|PlannedDate, catchUp}, sequential and completedByChildren. Returns one result per task (id, ok/error, task record); a bad item does not stop the others.

tasks.description: tasks to create, applied in order

completedByChildren.description: completes when its last subtask does

project.description: project id; omit both project and parent for the inbox

anchor.description: the date the rule moves: DeferDate, DueDate or PlannedDate

scheduleType.description: Regularly (fixed schedule) or FromCompletion (counts from completion)

tools.name: add_tasks

anchor.description: the date the rule moves: DeferDate, DueDate or PlannedDate

scheduleType.description: Regularly (fixed schedule) or FromCompletion (counts from completion)

tools.description: Permanently delete tasks, projects, tags or folders. IRREVERSIBLE. Guards: a tag or folder is deleted only when already dropped and empty (delete children first); a task or project is deleted only without remaining (incomplete) tasks or subtasks; drop it instead. Returns one result per item; a refusal comes back as that item's error with the reason.

items.description: objects to act on, applied in order

tools.name: delete

tools.description: Drop tasks, projects, tags or folders. Reversible through this server for projects and tags (edit status back to Active) and tasks (edit_tasks restore true); a dropped folder (which also drops its projects) cannot be restored through these tools. Dropping a project drops its tasks. Guard enforced by OmniFocus script: a tag is refused while it or any descendant tag has remaining tasks (untag or complete them first). Returns one result per item; a refusal comes back as that item's error.

items.description: objects to act on, applied in order

tools.name: drop

tools.description: Patch projects, tags or folders in one batch: rename; project status Active/OnHold/Done; tag status Active/OnHold; sequential (project); review (project only): reviewInterval {steps>=1, unit days|weeks|months|years}, nextReviewDate (truncated to local midnight), reviewed true to mark reviewed now (recomputes nextReviewDate; not with nextReviewDate); move under a parent id or to the root (parent null); reorder before or after a sibling of the same kind. Folders: rename, move, reorder only. Dropping and deleting are separate tools. Returns one result per item.

items.description: patches applied in order; omitted field = unchanged

move.description: parent: folder id (project, folder), tag id (tag) or null for the root

nextReviewDate.description: project only; OmniFocus truncates it to local midnight; not with reviewed

reorder.description: mutually exclusive with move; the sibling's parent becomes the parent

reviewInterval.description: project only; cannot be cleared; does not move nextReviewDate

reviewed.description: project only: mark reviewed now; OmniFocus recomputes nextReviewDate from the interval

status.description: project: Active, OnHold, Done; tag: Active, OnHold (Active re-activates a dropped tag); folders have no status edit

tools.name: edit

tools.description: Patch tasks in one batch: name, note, flagged, defer/due/planned (null clears), complete or uncomplete, move to a project, the inbox or a parent task, tags add/remove by id or name, estimatedMinutes and repetition (null clears), sequential, completedByChildren, restore true to un-drop a dropped task (not with complete). Returns one result per patch (id, ok/error, updated task record).

patches.description: patches applied in order; omitted field = unchanged, null clears note/defer/due/planned/estimatedMinutes/repetition

completedByChildren.description: completes when its last subtask does

anchor.description: the date the rule moves: DeferDate, DueDate or PlannedDate

scheduleType.description: Regularly (fixed schedule) or FromCompletion (counts from completion)

restore.description: un-drop a dropped task; not with complete

tools.name: edit_tasks

anchor.description: the date the rule moves: DeferDate, DueDate or PlannedDate

scheduleType.description: Regularly (fixed schedule) or FromCompletion (counts from completion)
